question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17f4a23ca2f76eca6986cdbdd5dcefe93b6f9084b89c8200a7d1087fe8838156.png]
solution: The pattern followed in the given series is: • ** Arrow with the black dot changes the direction of its head in each step.** • **Rest of the arrows moves in clockwise direction.** **​**Next step will be: Since the motion is in clockwise direction, the arrows will repeat the first step. Arrow with black dot will change the direction of it head to right.
